title: Cohors Cthulhu spells
description: source/data/spells.json: spells by tradition, then by name. The name is what the Spell Name dropdown shows (and an NPC import names). The build checks the file against this schema (generate.js).

propertyNames.description: The tradition, as the Spells tab's Magical Tradition options spell it.

skill.description: The skill the casting roll uses.

difficulty.description: The number of successes needed, as the first number in the text; anything else (an opposed test) is shown as text.

cost.description: The number of Challenge Dice, then the cost's damage effects, comma-separated ("5 Drain, Piercing 1"). The casting roll rolls it.

category.description: The kind of spell ("Attack spell", "Ward spell"). A category containing "attack" shows the Damage & Effects field on the spell's row.

damage_effects.description: Attack spells: the damage the spell does, in the format of a weapon's Damage & Effects: the base rating in Challenge Dice, then the damage effects, comma-separated ("2, Piercing 1"; "2, Stun"). The casting roll rolls the caster's Power plus this rating in Challenge Dice, like a weapon's damage; each Momentum spent on Spell Effects adds a die, up to 3. Leave it out for spells that do no damage.
